_comment: Intended toolkit-vs-runtime skill differences. Written by `scripts/skill_drift.py --declare`; each entry is pinned to both copies' fingerprints and goes stale when either side changes.

avoid-ai-writing.reason: Runtime SKILL.md was split into references/ (options, word-lists, structural-patterns) on 261002; the toolkit copy keeps one inline SKILL.md (size-ratcheted) and ships its own check-style.js. The docs-genre reference and the two doc check scripts are identical in both copies; the toolkit points to them from README.md.

bio-constants.reason: Toolkit copy sanitized: every example reaction, accession and EC number is a textbook entry (malate dehydrogenase, E. coli mdh, formate dehydrogenase) with fixtures re-recorded from the public databases, the package-route test no longer depends on whether equilibrator-api is installed, the equilibrator venv path is OS-aware, and SKILL.md is rewritten without maintainer paths, rule ids or private skill links.

code-quality.reason: Reverse-direction: toolkit is ahead, not behind. Toolkit's Mode C section already has the 260924-era two-axis review split (Standards vs Spec, reviewed and reported separately, quote-the-request rule) that runtime's older SKILL.md (dated 2026-03-16, months before toolkit's 2026-08-22) does not have. Porting runtime's SKILL.md over toolkit's would delete real content, not add it.

endnote-citation-injection.reason: Toolkit keeps its split SKILL.md + references/ layout and an English, sanitized body: no maintainer record ids, manuscript or person names, paths or Korean trigger phrases; docs/ ledger not shipped; scripts ported with generic fixtures.

experiment-hub.reason: toolkit copy sanitized: license MIT, synthetic test fixtures and example canon registry instead of the maintainer's lab data, generic examples and no project history; publishing to a Methods folder is opt-in (nothing configured = skipped, not exit 3). Ported 261013: serial dilution (default auto), the Pipetting Guide enzyme-preparation block, cocktail_dead_volume_uL, the x1.0 / 5 uL dead-volume surplus defaults, the reaction_matrix calc subcommand (dilution_calc), the structural workbook guards in pipetting_checks (with the empty-cache count fix) and the workbook-editing rules, tested on synthetic fixtures (tests/test_structural_guards.py).

generate-image.reason: Toolkit is ahead: runtime Related Skills still names scientific-slides and latex-posters, which the toolkit does not ship (it routes to journal-ppt and publication-figures instead), and the toolkit script carries the Windows UTF-8 stdout fix the runtime lacks.

lab-data-analysis.reason: Ported 261118: the HPLC vial / sample name / injection index identifier rule, rewritten without dates of incidents or quotes. Not ported: the runtime absence-check section and scripts/absence_check.py (bound to the maintainer's HPLC raw roots, a legacy path map and a cloud-synced metadata catalog) and the replicate dispensing check (project-specific). The toolkit keeps its own PeakPicker routing table and description.

lab-record.reason: toolkit copy points Asana reads at scripts/connectors/asana_connector.py instead of the maintainer-only asana-extended-api skill

markitdown.reason: Reverse direction plus the runtime fix: toolkit SKILL.md already carries the prompt-injection section, a generic schematics pointer and the Windows UTF-8 stdout fix in both scripts, none of which the runtime copy has. The runtime example_usage.md fix (OpenRouter base_url and valid slugs) was ported 261118.

paper-extract.reason: Env-dependence: runtime SKILL.md points its Script Location at ~/.claude/scripts/extract_paper_assets.py (the maintainer's personal layout, 260904 audit), while the toolkit ships its own self-contained copy under skills/paper-extract/scripts/ so a distribution install works standalone.

patent-invention-disclosure.reason: Env-dependence: the runtime addition documents a Stop hook (hooks/patent_qc_gate_stop.sh wired into the maintainer's own stop_hook.sh, 260912) that only exists in that person's Claude Code settings.json wiring, not something a toolkit distribution install has or can port.

primer-design.reason: Toolkit copy is maintained independently: MIT licence (runtime says Proprietary), a different module split (order_sheet_writers, vector_construct_map, mcp tool groups, characterization tests) and its own tests. Ported 261118: the NEB Tm Calculator lookup (neb_tm.py, consent-gated), its 13 offline tests, the REFERENCE.md section and references/tm-and-cycling.md. Not ported: templates/claude-web-export.md and tests/test_md_vs_direct.py (maintainer's Claude-web export workflow).

research-ideation.reason: toolkit copy sanitized: license MIT, maintainer-specific recipe, workbook IDs, machine wording and personal rule/tool names generalized

research-search.reason: Toolkit routing is the key-less one: no paid web-search backends are listed (the runtime change only removes dead commands for the retired paid skills), and it carries the preprint route, ref_fetch.py download routes and the institutional-link policy. The runtime copy routes to skills the toolkit does not ship (researcher-finder, web-scraping libkey / EZproxy login, paid backend status tables with maintainer secrets paths).

skill-developer.reason: Rewritten generically 261118 around the SKILL.md description as the trigger, an optional router hook and one measured firing (no skill-rules.json, which nothing ever read). Not ported: the maintainer's domain_skill_router.sh wiring, the skills-improve-themselves section (skill_draft.py, skill_autoapply), rule ids and the private skill names in the trigger table.

statsmodels.reason: Reverse-direction: toolkit is ahead here, not lagging. Toolkit added references/model_selection.md (AIC/BIC, R-style formulas, CV caveats) after the runtime copy was last touched; nothing to port from runtime, the addition should go the other way eventually.

token-efficient-routing.reason: Generic parts ported 261118 (the pinned-model-is-a-request trap, tier names are classes, unpinned-agent corollary). Not ported: the Tools section (routing_doctor.py, agent_model_check.py, maintainer agent definitions), account-bound model pricing and the Fable tier facts, measured incident ids and the link to the private token-quota-ops skill.

verification-gates.reason: Toolkit router is an English, generic rewrite: it names the toolkit's own skills (compat-check, provenance-check, fiducial, regress-check, endnote-citation-injection, experiment-hub canon_gate, bio-constants) and carries the seven-gate table and the nondeterminism rule; the runtime copy additionally carries maintainer repo paths, rule ids, an unattended-guard section and links to private skills (a refactor-safety gate, a crawl self-improvement loop) that the toolkit does not ship.
